tools.name: check_billing_and_qris_status
tools.description: Check QRIS top-up order payment status (PENDING or PAID), current workspace credit balance, credit mutation ledger history, and official downloadable PDF invoice URLs. Use this tool to verify whether an order from create_qris_invoice has settled or to audit credit consumption; do not use it to generate a new payment invoice (use create_qris_invoice instead) or view campaign click rates (use get_campaign_analytics instead). Read-only operation requiring PUSHNOTIF_API_KEY with 0 credit cost; pass order_id to inspect a single invoice or omit it to list recent orders and ledger entries. Returns JSON { credits_balance, orders: [{ id, amount_rp, credits_added, status, invoice_pdf_url, created_at }], recent_ledger: [{ id, delta, reason, created_at }] }.

order_id.description: Optional specific QRIS order ID in format ord_xxxx (from create_qris_invoice) to check; omit to return the latest orders and ledger history

tools.name: configure_email_automation
tools.description: Configure per-app module switches (ON/OFF) for Transactional Email OTP, Automated Payment Webhook Email Receipts, Order Status Emails, and the Web Push Notification collector, plus sender brand name and Reply-To email address. Use this tool to enable or disable individual channels per website; do not use it to send an immediate email or OTP (use send_transactional_email instead). Requires PUSHNOTIF_API_KEY and costs 0 credits. Returns JSON { ok, app_id, push_enabled, email_otp_enabled, email_invoice_enabled, email_status_enabled, email_brand_name, email_reply_to }.

app_id.description: Target application ID in format app_xxxx (obtain from list_apps)

push_enabled.description: Set true to enable Web Push Notification collection on the website, or false to disable

email_otp_enabled.description: Set true to enable 6-digit Email OTP generation and verification for this app

email_invoice_enabled.description: Set true to automatically send paid invoice receipts via email when a payment webhook arrives

email_status_enabled.description: Set true to enable order status and shipping tracking emails

email_brand_name.description: Sender brand name shown in the recipient inbox (e.g., 'Kopi Nusantara')

email_reply_to.description: Business Reply-To email address where customer replies are routed

tools.name: configure_inapp_banner
tools.description: Configure and publish an on-site In-App Popup or Banner (center modal, top sticky bar, or bottom slide-in toast) rendered inside the website by the PushNotif SDK without requiring browser push permission. Use this tool for visual in-page promos and announcements; do not use it for OS lock-screen notifications (use send_push_notification instead). Prerequisite: call list_apps first to obtain app_id. Requires PUSHNOTIF_API_KEY; saving configuration is idempotent and costs 0 credits, while each live visitor display deducts 1 credit (inapp_trigger controls when the banner fires—such as 'scroll_50' for 50% page scroll or 'event:add_to_cart' for custom DOM events—combined with inapp_freq to cap repeat impressions per visitor). Returns JSON { ok, app_id, inapp_enabled, inapp_style, inapp_trigger, inapp_freq }.

app_id.description: Target application ID in format app_xxxx (obtain from list_apps)

inapp_enabled.description: Set true to publish the banner live on the website, or false to pause it (default: true)

inapp_style.description: Visual layout: 'modal' (center dialog), 'top_bar' (sticky top ribbon), or 'bottom_slide' (corner slide-in toast)

inapp_trigger.description: Trigger condition: 'immediate' (default), 'delay_5s', 'delay_10s', 'scroll_50', 'scroll_80', or custom DOM event 'event:<name>'

inapp_body.description: Banner supporting message text (1 to 240 characters)

inapp_cta_text.description: Optional CTA button label (must be paired with inapp_cta_url to render a clickable action button)

inapp_cta_url.description: Optional HTTPS destination URL opened when the CTA button is clicked

inapp_accent.description: Optional 6-digit hex color code for the CTA button and accent border (default: '#0058BE')

inapp_freq.description: Per-visitor frequency cap: 'once_forever' (one-time announcement per visitor, never shown again), 'once_per_session' (default), 'once_per_day', 'cooldown_3h', 'cooldown_12h', 'once_per_week', or 'always'

segment_tag.description: Optional target segment/merchant tag (e.g., 'seblak-nearby') to display a dedicated In-App Banner on pages matching that tag under a single shared App ID (default: 'all' for global fallback)

inapp_template_id.description: Optional template preset: 'default', 'ai_custom' (custom HTML card), 'voucher_copy', 'flash_timer', 'feature_grid', or 'event_invite'

inapp_custom_html.description: Optional raw HTML card markup when inapp_template_id is ai_custom (renders up to 96vw x 94vh)

inapp_image_url.description: Optional HTTPS image/poster URL (supports transparent PNG/WEBP)

inapp_image_size.description: Optional poster width preset when using image_only: 'compact', 'standard' (default), 'large', 'xl', or 'full'

inapp_image_transparent.description: Set true when using a transparent PNG/WEBP poster in image_only style so no card box is rendered

tools.name: configure_payment_webhook
tools.description: Generate the ready-to-paste Universal Incoming Webhook URL (POST /api/v1/apps/{app_id}/incoming-event) for 9 auto-detected formats (Midtrans, Xendit, Mayar, Lynk.id, Duitku, Tripay, Supabase Database/Auth, Saweria/Trakteer, Shopify, WooCommerce, GitHub, and Custom JSON), or trigger a live test event when simulate_test=true. Use this tool when connecting a payment gateway, Supabase backend, creator tipping page, or e-commerce store to automatically show a Live Activity Toast, broadcast a Web Push, and/or send a transactional receipt email upon settlement; do not use it for RSS blog feeds (use configure_rss_autopush instead) or manual push campaigns (use send_push_notification instead). Prerequisite: call list_apps first to obtain app_id. Requires PUSHNOTIF_API_KEY; generating the webhook URL costs 0 credits, while live or simulated push broadcasts deduct 1 credit per delivered device (toast_only mode costs 0 credits on display). Returns JSON { ok, app_id, mode, webhook_url, supported_platforms, setup_guides, simulation_result }.

app_id.description: Target application ID in format app_xxxx (obtain from list_apps)

mode.description: Action when incoming webhook event arrives: 'both' (default: show Live Activity Toast on website + send Web Push), 'toast_only' (show Live Activity Toast only, 0 credits), or 'push_only' (send Web Push notification only)

simulate_test.description: Set true to immediately fire a test incoming webhook event to verify Live Activity Toast and Web Push delivery

platform.description: Platform format to simulate when simulate_test=true: 'midtrans' (default), 'supabase', 'saweria', 'shopify', 'xendit', 'woocommerce', or 'github'

buyer_name.description: Optional custom actor/buyer name for test simulation (default: 'Budi (Jakarta)')

item_name.description: Optional custom product/order/table name for test simulation (default: 'Paket Premium Rp 149.000')

tools.name: configure_rss_autopush
tools.description: Configure automated 24/7 RSS, Atom, or XML Sitemap polling for an app_id, or trigger an immediate feed check and push broadcast via dispatch_now=true. Use this tool when a blog, news portal, or store wants newly published URLs automatically broadcast as push notifications; do not use it for manual one-off messages (use send_push_notification instead) or fixed-time calendar campaigns (use schedule_push_notification instead). Prerequisite: call list_apps first to obtain app_id. Requires PUSHNOTIF_API_KEY; feed URLs are validated against SSRF rules, deduplicated by item GUID/URL so each post is sent only once, and deduct 1 credit per delivered subscriber when a new item is broadcast (setting dispatch_now=true immediately fetches and broadcasts the newest feed entry even if rss_enabled=false). Returns JSON { ok, app_id, rss_enabled, rss_feed_url, rss_interval, dispatched_now, latest_item_title }.

app_id.description: Target application ID in format app_xxxx (obtain from list_apps)

rss_enabled.description: Set true to enable background RSS/Sitemap polling at rss_interval, or false to pause background polling

rss_feed_url.description: Public HTTPS URL of the RSS 2.0, Atom, or XML Sitemap feed (required when enabling polling or calling dispatch_now=true)

rss_prefix.description: Optional text prepended to each auto-generated notification title (e.g., 'Artikel Baru: ')

dispatch_now.description: Set true to immediately fetch the latest feed entry and broadcast it to active subscribers right now

tools.name: configure_social_toast
tools.description: Configure the standalone on-site Live Activity Social Proof Toast (corner notification card showing recent subscriber joins, logins, and purchases) and its 3 automated DOM/webhook sensors for an app_id without overwriting the In-App Promo Banner. Use this tool to enable/disable social proof toasts, change visual theme or screen corner, or toggle auto-capture sensors; do not use it for promo popups (use configure_inapp_banner instead). Requires PUSHNOTIF_API_KEY and costs 0 credits. Returns JSON { ok, app_id, toast_enabled, toast_theme, toast_position, toast_action, sensors }.

app_id.description: Target application ID in format app_xxxx (obtain from list_apps)

toast_enabled.description: Set true to enable Live Activity Toast on the website, or false to turn it off

toast_custom_title.description: Optional custom headline override for the Live Toast (leave empty to use automated sensor feed)

toast_custom_body.description: Optional custom message body override for the Live Toast

toast_custom_html.description: Optional bespoke HTML/CSS markup when toast_theme='ai_custom'

toast_custom_url.description: Optional HTTPS URL opened when toast_action='custom_url'

toast_sensor_sub.description: Auto-show toast when a new visitor subscribes to push notifications

toast_sensor_auth.description: Auto-detect signup/login forms on the website

toast_sensor_buy.description: Auto-detect checkout/payment forms and incoming payment webhooks

tools.name: create_app
tools.description: Register a new website domain or mobile application under the authenticated workspace and generate its unique ECDSA P-256 VAPID keypair and 1-line HTML SDK snippet. Use this tool when adding an additional website or app to an existing account; do not use it to modify an existing app's icon, welcome push, or mobile keys (use update_app_branding instead) or to remove an app (use delete_app instead). Requires PUSHNOTIF_API_KEY, costs 0 credits, and creates a persistent app record where site_url must be a valid HTTPS origin (or http://localhost for local testing). Returns JSON { ok, app: { id, site_name, site_url, vapid_public_key, created_at }, sdk_snippet }.

site_name.description: Display name of the website or mobile application (2 to 80 characters)

site_url.description: Canonical HTTPS origin URL of the website (must start with https:// or http://localhost)

tools.name: create_qris_invoice
tools.description: Create a prepaid credit top-up invoice payable via Indonesian QRIS (all banks and e-wallets) at a flat rate of Rp 0.20 per credit (Rp 1,000 = 5,000 non-expiring credits). Use this tool when the user wants to purchase additional credits; do not use it to check whether an existing invoice has been paid (use check_billing_and_qris_status instead). Requires PUSHNOTIF_API_KEY, generates a PENDING order valid for 30 minutes at 0 fee, and automatically credits the workspace upon payment webhook confirmation; if both package_id and custom amount_rp are supplied, amount_rp takes precedence (minimum Rp 1,000). Returns JSON { ok, order: { id, amount_rp, credits_added, status, qris_checkout_url, expires_at } }.

package_id.description: Preset package tier: 'starter' (Rp 20,000 = 100,000 credits), 'growth' (Rp 50,000 = 250,000 credits), or 'pro' (Rp 100,000 = 500,000 credits); ignored if amount_rp is explicitly provided

amount_rp.description: Custom top-up amount in Indonesian Rupiah (minimum 1000, maximum 10000000; 1 IDR = 5 lifetime credits, overrides package_id)

tools.name: delete_app
tools.description: Permanently delete a registered application (app_id) along with all of its subscriber device tokens, scheduled campaigns, and delivery history. Use this tool only when a user explicitly asks to remove a duplicate or decommissioned app; do not use it to pause notifications or change app settings (use update_app_branding or configure_inapp_banner instead). Prerequisite: call list_apps first to verify the exact app_id and active subscriber count. Requires PUSHNOTIF_API_KEY, costs 0 credits, and is irreversibly destructive (confirm_delete must be set to true or the call is rejected). Returns JSON { ok, deleted_app_id, deleted_site_name, subscribers_removed }.

app_id.description: Target application ID in format app_xxxx to permanently delete (obtain from list_apps)

confirm_delete.description: Safety confirmation flag: must be explicitly set to true to execute permanent deletion

tools.name: get_campaign_analytics
tools.description: Retrieve historical push campaign delivery metrics (delivered count, click count, CTR percentage, credits spent) and active scheduled queue items (cmp_sch_xxxx). Use this tool to audit campaign performance or look up scheduled campaign IDs before editing or canceling them with schedule_push_notification; do not use it to inspect QRIS payment invoices (use check_billing_and_qris_status instead) or subscriber device lists (use list_subscribers instead). Read-only operation requiring PUSHNOTIF_API_KEY with 0 credit cost; omitting app_id aggregates metrics across all workspace apps up to limit rows. Returns JSON { summary: { total_sent, total_clicks, avg_ctr_percent }, campaigns: [{ id, app_id, title, delivered_count, click_count, ctr_percent, created_at }], scheduled_queue: [{ id, app_id, title, scheduled_for, recurrence_rule, status }] }.

app_id.description: Optional application ID filter in format app_xxxx (omit to aggregate across all workspace apps)

limit.description: Maximum number of recent campaigns to return (1 to 50, default: 10)

tools.name: list_apps
tools.description: List all registered websites and mobile apps in the workspace with active subscriber counts, current credit balance, and optional framework SDK installation snippets (when include_sdk_framework is set). Use this tool first as a prerequisite to obtain a valid app_id before calling send_push_notification, schedule_push_notification, update_app_branding, delete_app, configure_inapp_banner, or configure_rss_autopush; do not use it to inspect individual subscriber devices (use list_subscribers instead). Read-only operation requiring PUSHNOTIF_API_KEY with 0 credit cost; when include_sdk_framework is passed ('html', 'nextjs', 'laravel', 'wordpress', 'flutter'), each app entry also includes ready-to-paste SDK setup code. Returns JSON { tenant_name, credits_balance, total_apps, apps: [{ id, site_name, site_url, active_subscribers, sdk_guide }] }.

app_id.description: Optional specific app_id (format app_xxxx) to filter and inspect in detail

include_sdk_framework.description: Optional target stack ('html', 'nextjs', 'laravel', 'wordpress', or 'flutter') to include copy-paste SDK & service worker installation code

tools.name: list_subscribers
tools.description: Retrieve active subscriber device records, assigned segment tags, platform breakdown counts (Web VAPID, Android FCM, iOS APNs), or full CSV/JSON backup export for zero-downtime migration. Use this tool to inspect audience size, platform distribution, export subscriber tokens (export_format="csv" or "json"), or obtain a subscriber_id before calling update_subscriber_tags; do not use it to view campaign click metrics (use get_campaign_analytics instead) or modify/import subscribers (use update_subscriber_tags instead). Read-only operation requiring PUSHNOTIF_API_KEY with 0 credit cost; filter by app_id and optional tag to narrow results. Returns JSON { total_active, platform_breakdown: { web, android_fcm, ios_apns }, subscribers: [{ id, app_id, platform, tags, created_at }], export_data }.

app_id.description: Optional application ID filter in format app_xxxx (omit to aggregate across all apps in the workspace)

tag.description: Optional segment tag filter (returns only subscribers carrying this tag)

limit.description: Maximum number of subscriber records to return (1 to 100, default: 15)

export_format.description: Optional backup export format: 'csv' or 'json' to include full VAPID endpoint/p256dh/auth migration dump for the specified app_id

tools.name: login_existing_account
tools.description: Authenticate an existing PushNotif account using email and password to retrieve its live API key and registered apps, with optional inline profile name or password update (when new_name or new_password is provided). Use this tool for existing users connecting from chat or updating account credentials; do not use it for new signups (use register_new_account instead) or app-level branding (use update_app_branding instead). Requires valid email and password (no prior API key needed), costs 0 credits, and is rate-limited against brute-force attempts; read-only unless new_name or new_password is supplied. Returns JSON { ok, tenant: { id, name, email, api_key, credits }, apps: [{ id, site_name, site_url }], profile_updated }.

new_name.description: Optional new workspace display name (2 to 80 characters) to update upon login

new_password.description: Optional new account password (minimum 6 characters) to replace the current password

tools.name: register_new_account
tools.description: Two-step onboarding tool to request a 6-digit email OTP (step 1: omit otp_code) or verify the OTP to create a new PushNotif account with 1,000 free lifetime credits, register the initial website, and return a live API key (step 2: pass otp_code, password, and name). Use this tool only for brand-new user signups; do not use it for existing accounts (use login_existing_account instead) or to add websites to an existing account (use create_app instead). Public endpoint requiring no API key; step 1 is rate-limited to 5 OTPs per 10 minutes per IP (valid 10 minutes), while step 2 irreversibly creates a tenant and ECDSA P-256 VAPID keypair. Returns JSON { ok, step, tenant: { id, name, email, api_key, credits }, app: { id, site_name, site_url, vapid_public_key } }.

email.description: Email address to register (must not already belong to an existing PushNotif account)

name.description: Workspace or company display name (2 to 80 characters; required when verifying otp_code)

password.description: Account login password (minimum 6 characters; required when verifying otp_code)

otp_code.description: Optional 6-digit numeric OTP from email: omit on first call to send the OTP email, then provide on second call to complete registration

site_name.description: Optional display name for the initial website or app (defaults to workspace name)

site_url.description: Optional full HTTPS origin URL of the initial website (e.g., https://example.com)

tools.name: schedule_push_notification
tools.description: Create a new scheduled or recurring push notification campaign, edit an existing queued campaign (via update_campaign_id), or cancel a queued campaign before execution (via cancel_campaign_id). Use this tool for delayed, recurring, or editable future broadcasts; do not use it for immediate sending (use send_push_notification instead) or automated RSS feed polling (use configure_rss_autopush instead). Prerequisite: call list_apps to obtain app_id, or call get_campaign_analytics to obtain an existing cmp_sch_xxxx ID for editing or cancellation. Requires PUSHNOTIF_API_KEY; scheduling, editing, or canceling costs 0 credits up front, and 1 credit per delivered device is deducted only when the schedule fires (mutually exclusive modes: pass cancel_campaign_id to delete, update_campaign_id to modify fields in-place, or neither to create a new schedule). Returns JSON { ok, action, scheduled_campaign: { id, app_id, title, body, scheduled_for, recurrence_rule, status } }.

app_id.description: Target application ID in format app_xxxx (required when creating a new schedule)

title.description: Notification headline (1 to 100 characters; required when creating, optional when editing via update_campaign_id)

body.description: Notification body text (1 to 240 characters; required when creating, optional when editing via update_campaign_id)

url.description: Optional HTTPS destination URL opened when the notification is tapped

scheduled_for.description: ISO-8601 execution timestamp with timezone offset (e.g., '2026-10-21T08:00:00+07:00')

recurrence_rule.description: Recurrence pattern: 'once' (default), 'daily', 'twice_daily', 'weekly', 'monthly', 'every_30m', 'every_3h', 'every_6h', or a 5-field cron expression

update_campaign_id.description: Optional existing scheduled campaign ID (format cmp_sch_xxxx from get_campaign_analytics) to edit in-place with new title, body, url, scheduled_for, or recurrence_rule

cancel_campaign_id.description: Optional existing scheduled campaign ID (format cmp_sch_xxxx from get_campaign_analytics) to cancel and remove from the queue

tools.name: send_push_notification
tools.description: Broadcast an immediate push notification across Web Push (VAPID), Android (FCM), and iOS (APNs) to active subscribers of a specific app_id. Use this tool for instant real-time delivery; do not use it for future or recurring broadcasts (use schedule_push_notification instead) or on-site HTML popups (use configure_inapp_banner instead). Prerequisite: call list_apps first to obtain app_id. Requires PUSHNOTIF_API_KEY, deducts 1 credit (Rp 0.20) per successfully delivered device (0 credits charged for 404/410 dead tokens, which are auto-pruned), and is irreversible once dispatched; when segment is set to a custom tag (from update_subscriber_tags) instead of 'all', only subscribers carrying that tag receive the broadcast, and omitting url defaults the tap action to the app's registered site_url. Returns JSON { ok, campaign_id, total_targeted, total_delivered, total_gone_pruned, credits_deducted, credits_remaining }.

app_id.description: Target application ID in format app_xxxx (obtain from list_apps)

title.description: Notification headline shown on the lock screen (1 to 100 characters)

body.description: Notification message body text (1 to 240 characters)

url.description: Optional HTTPS destination URL opened when the notification is tapped (defaults to app's site_url)

segment.description: Target audience filter: 'all' (default) or a specific subscriber/merchant tag assigned via data-tags, PushNotif.addTag(), or update_subscriber_tags

icon_url.description: Optional HTTPS URL of a custom notification icon/logo (e.g., per-merchant logo override on a shared App ID)

tools.name: send_transactional_email
tools.description: Send a 1-to-1 locked transactional email (6-digit OTP challenge, paid invoice receipt, or order shipping status update) or verify a 6-digit OTP code entered by a user. Use this tool for transactional 1-to-1 emails and managed OTP verification; bulk marketing or promotional blasts are strictly prohibited. Requires PUSHNOTIF_API_KEY; sending an email or OTP deducts 25 credits (Rp 5), while verifying an OTP code (action=verify_otp) costs 0 credits. Returns JSON delivery receipt or OTP verification token.

app_id.description: Target application ID in format app_xxxx (obtain from list_apps)

action.description: Operation mode: 'send_otp' (generate & email 6-digit OTP), 'verify_otp' (verify 6-digit code), 'send_invoice' (send paid receipt email), or 'send_order_status' (send order/shipping update)

to_email.description: Single recipient email address (1-to-1 transactional only)

reference_id.description: Invoice number or Order ID (e.g., 'INV-2026-001' or 'ORD-99281' for send_invoice / send_order_status)

detail_text.description: Transaction amount/items or shipping courier tracking info (e.g., 'Rp 85.000 — Kopi Susu' or 'DIKIRIM — Resi JNE: JP882910')

tools.name: update_app_branding
tools.description: Update an existing application's notification icon URL, automated welcome push message (including drip delay welcome_delay_sec and promo target URL welcome_url), zero-downtime custom VAPID keys (vapid_public_key & vapid_private_key for migrating from OneSignal/LaraPush), and optional native mobile push credentials (Android FCM HTTP v1 service account JSON and iOS APNs .p8 key). Use this tool to configure app-level branding, onboarding welcome alerts, custom VAPID key migration, or native mobile credentials; do not use it to create a new app (use create_app instead) or configure on-site HTML popups (use configure_inapp_banner instead). Prerequisite: call list_apps first to obtain app_id. Requires PUSHNOTIF_API_KEY and idempotently updates only the fields provided at 0 configuration cost (when welcome_enabled=true, each new subscriber welcome push deducts 1 credit; APNs requires apns_key_id, apns_team_id, apns_bundle_id, and apns_p8_key together). Returns JSON { ok, app_id, icon_url, welcome_enabled, welcome_url, welcome_delay_sec, custom_vapid_updated, android_fcm_configured, ios_apns_configured }.

app_id.description: Target application ID in format app_xxxx (obtain from list_apps)

icon_url.description: Optional direct HTTPS URL to a square PNG/JPG/WebP brand icon (recommended 192x192px)

welcome_enabled.description: Set true to automatically send a welcome push notification immediately after a visitor subscribes

welcome_title.description: Headline of the automated welcome push notification (max 80 characters; used when welcome_enabled=true)

welcome_body.description: Body text of the automated welcome push notification (max 180 characters; used when welcome_enabled=true)

welcome_url.description: Optional target promo/onboarding HTTPS URL opened when the subscriber clicks the welcome push notification (defaults to site_url)

welcome_delay_sec.description: Optional drip delay in seconds (0 to 300, default: 0) before firing the welcome push notification after opt-in

vapid_public_key.description: Optional URL-safe Base64 VAPID Public Key imported from OneSignal, LaraPush, or Webpushr for zero-downtime migration

vapid_private_key.description: Optional URL-safe Base64 or PEM VAPID Private Key paired with vapid_public_key

fcm_service_account_json.description: Optional raw JSON string of Google Firebase Service Account key for native Android FCM HTTP v1 delivery

apns_key_id.description: Optional 10-character Apple Developer APNs Key ID (provide together with apns_team_id, apns_bundle_id, and apns_p8_key)

apns_p8_key.description: Optional full PEM content of Apple's AuthKey_XXXX.p8 private key file

tools.name: update_subscriber_tags
tools.description: Assign or remove audience segment tags on a subscriber device (subscriber_id), permanently unsubscribe a device (unsubscribe=true), or bulk-import existing Web Push subscribers via CSV or JSON array (import_app_id + import_csv or import_subscribers) at 0 credit cost. Use this tool to manage subscriber segmentation, remove a device, or migrate subscribers from OneSignal/LaraPush/Webpushr; do not use it to list or export subscribers (use list_subscribers instead). Requires PUSHNOTIF_API_KEY and costs 0 credits. Returns JSON { ok, subscriber_id, action, tags, removed, imported, updated }.

subscriber_id.description: Target subscriber device ID in format sub_xxxx (required when updating tags or unsubscribing a single device)

add_tags.description: Optional list of lowercase segment tag strings (e.g., ['vip', 'jakarta']) to attach to the subscriber for targeted broadcasts

remove_tags.description: Optional list of segment tag strings to remove from the subscriber

unsubscribe.description: Set true to permanently unsubscribe and delete this subscriber device record

import_app_id.description: Optional target app_id (app_xxxx) when performing a zero-downtime bulk subscriber import via import_csv or import_subscribers

import_csv.description: Optional CSV text containing endpoint,p256dh,auth,tags rows to bulk-import into import_app_id

import_subscribers.description: Optional JSON array of subscriber objects ({endpoint, p256dh, auth, tags}) to bulk-import into import_app_id
